label: Ubiquiti UniFi Cable Internet (UCI) DOCSIS 3.1 cable modem
description: 1U rack-mountable DOCSIS 3.1/3.0 cable modem with dual OFDM plus 32 SC-QAM downstream and dual OFDMA plus 8 SC-QAM upstream, wired as a single 2.5GbE RJ45 port.
notes: Ubiquiti tech specs: 'Networking interface: (1) 2.5 GbE RJ45 port'; 'RF interface: (1) Bluetooth v4.1, Upload: Dual OFDMA/(8) SC-QAM 5-42 MHz switchable 5-85 MHz, Download: Dual OFDM/(32) SC-QAM 108-1002 MHz'; 'DOCSIS interface: (1) DOCSIS 3.1/3.0'. Managed from UniFi Network (8.0.7+) through an upstream cloud gateway; acts as an unmanaged bridge once activated. The model code is UCI - this is the box sold as the Ubiquiti cable modem for UISP/UniFi ISP deployments.
